An 18-year-old is accused of murder in the death of a man who was shot inside his car in Fort Lauderdale. According to the Fort Lauderdale Police's preliminary investigation, the teen tried to steal the car before the shooting.

Jesús Enriques Villatoro is now being held at the Broward Sheriff’s Office Main Jail and is facing one murder charge and two counts of vehicle robbery with a firearm or other weapon, FLPD said.

The victim is identified as Luis Arcia Marin, 56, of Hialeah. Police said Marin was working as a rideshare driver at the time of the incident. No other passenger was in the car at the time.

Police seek owners of jewellery and personal items recovered in Southampton burglary investigation

Police are appealing for information to identify the owners of jewellery and personal items recovered during an investigation into two burglaries in Southampton.

The items, pictured in two images released by police, were recovered during an investigation involving Dariusz Serej, who was sentenced to two years in prison at Southampton Crown Court in April.

Serej, 46, of Northam Road, Southampton, pleaded guilty to two counts of burglary and one charge of taking a motor vehicle without the owner’s consent.

He admitted stealing various items and a Kia car from an address in Manor Farm Road in January. He also admitted to a burglary at an address in Chalk Lane in June.

However, the victims of the two burglaries have not recognised the jewellery and personal items recovered during the investigation.

Police are now urging anyone who recognises the items or believes they may belong to them
